findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "update_collection" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Update a collection's properties (name, parent_id, access, password, display_settings) by collection_id. Use get_collection first to see the current values.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_all_accounts, get_all_videos, get_organisation_history, get_video, get_video_history, get_account_history, get_account, get_videos_linked_to_account, get_collection_videos, get_collection_accounts · Private data: get_all_collections, update_collection · Public sink: get_all_accounts, bulk_track_accounts, get_all_videos, bulk_track_videos, get_video, get_account, get_videos_linked_to_account · Destructive: get_all_collections, delete_collection, remove_videos_from_collection, remove_accounts_from_collection.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_all_accounts, get_all_videos, get_organisation_history, get_video, get_video_history, get_account_history, get_account, get_videos_linked_to_account, get_collection_videos, get_collection_accounts · Private data: get_all_collections, update_collection · Public sink: get_all_accounts, bulk_track_accounts, get_all_videos, bulk_track_videos, get_video, get_account, get_videos_linked_to_account · Destructive: get_all_collections, delete_collection, remove_videos_from_collection, remove_accounts_from_collection

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
